Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The backend protocol already exposes placement for a DatasetRevisionSpec, and GeometryPaneHost can request it; this is material partial implementation. It still inherits the same adapter re-derivation problem and does not establish the complete native draft preview requested here: per-trial CoordinateTrail, tally provenance, DroppedInitial, corrections, and off-screen policy over an unadmitted revision. Consolidate this work with the native S3.7 placement route and add an explicit draft fixture assertion.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/backend/StudyBackend.scala:306
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/geometry/GeometryPaneHost.scala:37
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/geometry/PlacementPreviewAdapter.scala:27

Remaining / next action: Serve native draft tallies/trails with full placement semantics and add a draft-revision regression.

Disposition: Keep open.
